items.description: Ludei helps its users develop apps and games with HTML5. Developers can use any app framework or game engine they want. Ludei provides access to tools that perform remote testing and debugging directly on devices. Its cloud-based compilation system deploys across all platforms, producing the same set of HTML5 features on every device and OS. Users can access the cloud compilation system programmatically via REST API.
hasLockers is a cloud service for content locking based on hasOffers API.

A Twitter service that will automatically add anyone who follows you to a list. The list is automatically updated daily, so that it always reflects the people that are listening to you right now. Engage with the people following your tweets without crowding up your timeline.
glancemap helps you find or add you missed connection on the map, those people you randomly saw but never had the chance to talk to.

Veracity Media is a social marketing company that specializes in web design and development, social organization, and audience engagement and analytics. Veracity Media helps political campaigns, organizations, and individuals to inform, inspire, and engage their community with their campaigns/causes.
A ghost report community where you can post your true ghost encounter. Find and view other ghost encounters using the Google Maps map. Find similar cases around the world or in your town.
Measures the distance between two locations.
Doculib.org is a free pdf file sharing site using Bing Search Api.
so audible cloud music player, sync your tracks share with friends upload, quick share embed, html5, ipad, iphone, android, play music anywhere long mixes, meetings, sermons, podcasts, radio
Picomp'it is a service to create and host a photo contest, set some options, add photos from social networks, share your contest and see vote's results!
Use this bookmarklet to view a Twitter user's trstrank in your browser.

The Onion satire: click on the pins scattered around the globe to reveal mind-expanding factoids about the lesser, conquerable nations of the Earth. Come back each week to learn more about how little you know.
Aggregated feed of all Linkedin RSS feeds. Mashes up RSS feed questions and website published answers.
Dictamus is a dictation app for the iPhone, and this mashup allows users to send dictations directly from Dictamus to their Box.net accounts.

Subscribe to your Delicious TV feed and program your Boxe TV from delicous. Bookmark videos, genre listings, playlists, other peoples Delicious TV listings, etc. to delicious, then view them in Boxee.
ikasis is a YouTube video player. You can search for videos without reloading and breaking the actual video. The search result is played like a playlist. This is non-stop YouTube, like watching TV.
Share Twitter feeds with the person you're talking to on the phone.

The Wishpot web services allow you to create wishlists, track prices, and collect donations for the items desired. There are 3 shopping APIs: Wishlist and Registry Management, Price Alerts, and Chip in. You automatically become a Wishpot publisher and start accruing revenues immediately. Send email for docs. The main Wishpot site is for tagging items from a toolbar or widget as you shop so that you have a running list of things you want, plus price drop alerts. It also has social features like Facebook integration and friend management in one place.
Mobile Number Tracker traces the mobile numbers (of India only) with state, reference cities (exact or nearby city), service provider.
A twitter search engine powered by tweets to research prices
ShooSpy monitors what people are buying on Zappos in realtime.
